Toronto has also impressed defensively, allowing just 97 points per game through its first two contests, and will look to carry that momentum into a difficult matchup against Minnesota.

LaMelo Ball and Anthony Edwards give the Timberwolves an explosive backcourt capable of taking over games, while Rudy Gobert anchors the defense.
